column3: One literal- and parameter-free event per executed statement from the SQLAlchemy listener and the raw sqlite3 source (SqlTraceRecorder.capture, SqlPayload.java), also while the SQL Trace panel is paused when the journal records sql (SqlTraceRecorder.java:730-731); not ported: the RuntimeEvent fields executionId, threadKind and failedOrSlow, and SqlPayload.frames; dataSource and phase are always null (RequestPhase FILTERS/HANDLER/RESPONSE has no sharpit source, and the lifespan STARTUP/SHUTDOWN is not carried), codePathStamp is always 0, onEventLoop (K4) is not stamped; batchSize is 1 unbatched, N for a batch, 0 for a batch of unknown size (SqlTraceRecorder.java:650-652); completedNanos is started + duration on the perf_counter clock
